raw_translation: Kikomo cha kisheria cha kupunguzwa hutegemea mwaka wa kodi, uanachama wa safu ya pili na, bila safu ya pili, kuhitimu mapato yaliyopatikana. Akiba ya mwisho ya kodi pia hutegemea kaya, manispaa, kanton, kodi ya kanisa na kupunguzwa. Tumia ESTV calculator na maelezo sawa katika hali zote mbili na ongeza mchango wa safu ya ZXQPH0000QXZa tu kwa ya pili.
source: The legal deduction limit depends on the tax year, second-pillar membership and, without a second pillar, qualifying earned income. The final tax saving also depends on household, municipality, canton, church tax and deductions. Use the ESTV calculator with the same details in both scenarios and add the pillar 3a contribution only to the second.
